final: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS average_points, AVG(wins) AS average_wins FROM driverStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_wins) AS overall_average_wins FROM race_averages) SELECT race_averages.raceId, race_averages.average_points, race_averages.average_wins, race_averages.average_wins - overall_average.overall_average_wins FROM race_averages CROSS JOIN overall_average WHERE overall_average.overall_average_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (race_averages.average_wins - overall_average.overall_average_wins) IS NULL ASC, race_averages.average_wins - overall_average.overall_average_wins DESC LIMIT 10
